desc: Precompute `max_ending` (max subarray sum ending at each index) and `max_starting` (max subarray sum starting at each index) for the original array.
Calculate the global maximum subarray sum (`global_max`) of the original array.
Identify all unique elements in `nums` and their indices.
Implement Sparse Table for RMQ on `max_ending` to efficiently query `seg_max_sub` for any segment.
Iterate through each unique element $x$, identify the contiguous segments of non-$x$ elements, and for each segment compute its `sum`, `max_suffix`, `max_prefix`, and `max_sub`.
For each unique element $x$, run a modified Kadane's algorithm on the sequence of segments to find the maximum subarray sum after removing $x$.
Track the maximum of `global_max` and all calculated segment-based sums across all $x$.
